conventions.convention: Natural units c=ℏ=1, metric diag(-1,1,1,1), on-shell momenta p²=-m², and s+t+u=4m². The forward variable is v=s-2m², with gap ν₀=2m²>0 and crossing v↦-v.

B is the crossing-even, real-analytic, pole-subtracted function on the two-cut plane. Compact cut-bank continuity, uniform upper-half-plane growth B(w)=o(|w|²), convergent bank integrals, vanishing threshold arcs, and a nonnegative absorptive density with finite ν⁻³ moment are supplied assumptions.

cₙ=B^(2n)(0)/(2n)! starts at n=1; bₖ=ν₀^(2k+2)cₖ₊₁ starts at k=0. For N≥1, K_N imposes the unshifted quadratic inequalities for 2r≤N and the x and 1-x inequalities for 2r+1≤N. These are necessary tests without a realization converse.

Quartic polarization extracts [z₁z₂z₃z₄] without 1/4!, substitutes derivatives by ik, and uses all-incoming momenta. The contact map is defined only on the image of metric-contracted quartics, with an explicit certificate annihilating every declared relation in that subspace.
The positivity theorem assigns ρ(ν₀)=0 without asserting a threshold limit and concludes nonnegativity, allowing equality.

load_bearing.statement: The mathematical input consists of a massive identical-scalar forward slice, crossing-paired real pole subtraction, and a holomorphic real-analytic B on the two-cut plane, with compact-bank continuity, uniform o(|w|²) growth, nonnegative locally Riemann-integrable ρ, finite ∫ρ(ν)ν⁻³dν, convergent specified bank integrals, and vanishing endpoint arcs.

Under the complete defined gapped identical-scalar amplitude conditions, for every integer n≥1, B^(2n)(0)/(2n)!=(2/π)∫ from ν₀ to infinity of ρ(ν)/ν^(2n+1) dν≥0. Equality is allowed; no strict bound or sign for an arbitrary off-shell operator coefficient is asserted.

For integer N≥1, K_N⊂R^(N+1) consists exactly of vectors satisfying the three displayed quadratic families in their stated index ranges. Passing this finite test is necessary and is not defined to be sufficient for a full amplitude-data package.

For any amplitude data satisfying all the defined analytic, continuous-bank, endpoint and growth conditions, the normalized vector (b₀,…,b_N) belongs to K_N for every integer N≥1. These are necessary finite positivity tests, without a full-amplitude or physical-theory sufficiency assertion.

Under the stated finite-jet model and relation certificate, the scaled contact-coefficient map Q_D^(4)→C^(N+1) is well-defined, t_O is even, and coefficientwise-real representatives give real coordinates. For O₈=(∂μφ∂^μφ)², t_O₈(v)=8m⁴+4v² and M₈,N([C₈O₈])=(4ν₀²C₈/Λ⁴,0,…,0). This describes one contact insertion rather than exact full-amplitude matching.
For crossing-symmetric A and P, B(v)=A(2m²+v)-P(2m²+v) satisfies B(-v)=B(v); if B is complex differentiable near zero, B′(0)=0.
